C1537.title: Quantum Threat Mapping: Cryptographic Engineering Inventory Reveals Existential Threat to Public-Key Cryptography
C1537.summary: A preprint study published in September 2025 indicates that the advent of large-scale quantum computers, driven by Shor's algorithm and Grover's algorithm, poses an existential threat to modern public-key cryptography. This vulnerability stems from the ability of quantum computers to efficiently solve hard mathematical problems such as integer factorization and elliptic curve discrete logarithms,
